title: Exit-path liveness: overlapping polls, quote timeout, awaited alerts, watchdog order

options.name: Keep current behaviour
options.risk: Polls stack during an RPC stall, a hung Telegram request delays sells and the worker, and boot-time exits run before the watchdog exists.

options.name: Skip a poll tick while one is in flight, bound the quote with withTimeout, never await an alert before a money action, give the notifier a timeout, install the watchdog before any monitor
options.behavior_impact: Exit timing no longer depends on RPC tails or Telegram; no trading rule changes.
options.risk: Alerts may arrive after the sell instead of before it.

default: Keep current behaviour until the owning phase decides (milestone contract). Capital-relevant, but the linked findings are S2 or lower, so the default is safe to rest on until then.
behavior_impact: Decides whether alert delivery and slow RPC can delay an exit.
needed_by: Phase 24 discussion (capital fixes, after the Phase 23 real-path proof)
